title: The Drop of Tashkent
author: Orsen Okafor
blurb: Ines Oyelaran, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must burn the network that did the training before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
